title: Michael House
overview: You know, there's a lot of people out there named Michael. What if they lived under the same roof? What if they got into wacky hi-jinx? What if they were a family? Welcome to Michael House, the sitcom show with the wackiest yet most lovable family around. On episode [Redacted], we have a double feature for the family has an important special guest coming over. Will they be able to make arrangements in time and satisfy the upmost important requests?
